name: Waterloo / Mississauga
description: The Waterloo–Kitchener–Cambridge corridor launched with Square One and Milton connections and later gained campus express, transitway and seasonal shopping variants.

timeline.event: GO began Waterloo / Kitchener / Cambridge service to Square One with a Milton train-connection branch.
The launch table identifies route 25 and Milton-bound 25A.
The published family includes 25B,25C,25D and 25F as well as 25.
Seasonal weekend/holiday outlet-shopping service on 25L returned.
Seasonal weekend 25K began Toronto Premium Outlets–Kipling service via Square One, Dixie and Renforth, through 24 August.

gaps: Complete branch introduction dates remain unverified.

GTFS dates identify captured feeds, not necessarily the first or last day of a route. Open a pattern to see its exact scheduled service dates. Temporary rail replacement and special-service patterns are included when present in the source.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
